Custom Guitar Innovations browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Custom Guitar Innovations Fuzz Boost Published on June 12, 2007 Custom Guitar Innovations boost / preamp fuzz pedal Information Custom Guitar Innovations The item your viewing is Custom designing Fuzz/Boost pedal. This is the pedal you've been waiting for a mild smooth fuzz that doubles as a boost. The Fuzz Boost was designed to bring smooth singing transparent sustained fuzz that won't over color your rig. Fat round bottom and mids, the perfect addition to your sound. It nails that marshall brown sound perfectly.
